title: perilla citriodora
intro: Perilla citriodora, commonly known as Korean perilla, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, thanks to its numerous health benefits such as lowering cholesterol levels and blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Perilla citriodora include acting as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which helps to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, stress, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include perillaldehyde and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic effects.
